subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram onboarding: offer BotFather web app flow next to the chat flow

question: Should OpenClaw's Telegram onboarding and docs point users to the BotFather Mini App/web flow alongside the classic /newbot chat flow?
rationale: The change is small and non-runtime, but it adds an external deep-link recommendation to a stable first-run setup path and the issue has a protected maintainer label, so product intent should decide acceptance.

options.title: Accept dual-flow guidance
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if the wording stays limited to token creation/settings discoverability and includes adequate real setup proof.

options.title: Keep chat-only guidance
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if maintainers do not want OpenClaw onboarding to recommend the BotFather Mini App link.

options.title: Defer to broader setup design
options.body: Keep this issue open only if maintainers want it folded into a larger Telegram managed-bot or token-provisioning proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept dual-flow guidance
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if the wording stays limited to token creation/settings discoverability and includes adequate real setup proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the project lead listed in CONTRIBUTING and authored both the issue and the linked implementation PR.
